title: Maths Mela: Textbook of Mathematics for Grade 5 — Grade 5 Mathematics (CBSE / NCERT)

source.title: Maths Mela: Textbook of Mathematics for Grade 5
source.edition: First Edition June 2025 (Ashadha 1947); Reprinted February 2026; Reprint 2026-27; ISBN 978-93-5729-818-6
source.licence: Chapter and section titles as printed (facts); outcomes written by OpenPath in its own words; no textbook text is reproduced.

review.by: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from official and secondary sources; not an educator review)
review.note: Built from content/learning/syllabus/cbse-g05.json. Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://www.ncert.nic.in/textbook/pdf/eemm1ps.pdf https://www.ncert.nic.in/textbook/pdf/eemm101.pdf https://edustud.nic.in/edu/Syllabus_2026_27/5/5_math_english_2026_27.pdf https://ncert.nic.in/pdf/publication/otherpublications/tilops101.pdf. Notes: CBSE does not publish its own Classes 1-5 mathematics syllabus; CBSE schools follow the NCERT textbooks. The 2026-27 prescription was confirmed via official government split-up syllabi (Delhi Directorate of Education; KVS where available) and the NCERT reprint 2026-27 label. NCERT's 'Learning Outcomes at the Elementary Stage' (tilops101.pdf) could not be opened (robots-blocked); outcomes are written in my own words from the chapter content and the official DoE/KVS split-up outcomes. Outcomes are not copied from the textbook; questionTypes and difficulty are my judgement.
